correctness.rationale: For center-selected sets, peripheral closed-neighborhood support is s_i+1 versus outside m_i-s_i, and center support t+1 versus outside T-t; these give s_i=0 or s_i>=floor(m_i/2) and t>=floor(T/2). For center-unselected sets, support s_i versus outside m_i-s_i+1 gives s_i>=floor(m_i/2)+1; these bounds ensure domination. Exact binomial local choices with a center truncation count every set once. Minimization compares L+1 with sum_i floor(m_i/2)+r, with equality only for two odd blades. The included original-predicate verifier checked 251104 vertex subsets for 65 size vectors, 782 coefficients, and all minimum counts; finite verification is supplementary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This natural infinite family with a universal articulation point models global defensive constraints on heterogeneous modular components. The exact all-cardinality distribution refines a minimum parameter, and the center condition creates nonfactorizing cross-blade majority coupling. Optimizers have an exact new two-odd-blade disconnected exception and computable multiplicities. These are structurally motivated exact invariants rather than a numerical list, a trivial reparameterization of a known all-set theorem, or an unsupported broader claim.
